events.title: The Damghan earthquake strikes the eastern Alborz mountains
events.description: An earthquake of estimated magnitude 7.9 struck near Damghan, capital of the province of Qumis in the Abbasid Caliphate, with its worst shaking along some 350 kilometres of the eastern Alborz. It caused approximately 200,000 deaths, though the toll is debated.

events.title: The rebel Huang Chao captures Luoyang, eastern capital of the Tang
events.description: Huang Chao's rebel army quickly took Luoyang, the eastern capital of the Tang dynasty. Emperor Xizong then abandoned Chang'an for Chengdu, and Huang entered the capital and declared himself emperor of a new state of Qi.

events.title: Stephen of Blois is crowned king of England
events.description: Weeks after Henry I's death, his nephew Stephen was crowned at Westminster despite having sworn to support Henry's daughter, the Empress Matilda. The civil war that followed became known as the Anarchy.

events.title: Pope Honorius III confirms the Dominican Order
events.description: With the bull Religiosam vitam, Pope Honorius III gave universal recognition to the Order of Preachers founded by the Castilian priest Dominic de Guzmán. Already recognised by the bishop of Toulouse, the order followed the Rule of St Augustine.

events.title: Almería submits to the Catholic Monarchs
events.description: The port city of Almería, part of the Nasrid emirate of Granada, submitted to the sovereignty of the Catholic Monarchs, Ferdinand II of Aragon and Isabella I of Castile. The last Nasrid ruler, Muhammad XII, surrendered Granada itself in 1492.

events.title: The Old Pretender lands in Scotland, too late
events.description: James Francis Edward Stuart landed at Peterhead to lead the Jacobite rising. After the defeat at Preston and the stalemate at Sheriffmuir in November, the cause was failing, and he sailed back to France in February.

events.title: A court martial convicts Captain Alfred Dreyfus
events.description: A French military court convicted the Jewish officer Alfred Dreyfus of passing secrets to Germany and sentenced him to deportation for life. His innocence, and the cover-up, split France in the Dreyfus Affair.

events.title: The SR-71 Blackbird makes its first flight
events.description: Lockheed's SR-71 reconnaissance aircraft first flew at Palmdale, California. Able to cruise above Mach 3 at about 25,000 metres, it remains the fastest crewed jet-powered aircraft.
